# Facebook Marketplace Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-marketplace-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-marketplace-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.342**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract data from one or multiple Facebook Marketplace listings. Scrape data on apartments, whole categories, items for sale, prices, location and sellers. Export scraped data in JSON, CSV, and Excel, run the scraper via API, schedule and monitor runs or integrate with other tools.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Listing $0.0062, Add-on: Listing details $0.0062 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-marketplace-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-marketplace-scraper@0.0.342#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Facebook Marketplace URL you want to scrape — This lets you tell the scraper where to start. You can enter Facebook Marketplace URLs one by one. You can also link to or upload a text file with a list of URLs. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | ✍️ Number of listings — Select the number of listings you want to scrape. If this limit is not set, as many results as possible will be returned. |
| `includeListingDetails` | boolean |  | `false` | $ Add Listing Details — If enabled, extra details are scraped for each listing. This includes description, location coordinates, time stamp, listing attributes, and more. |
